text_blocks.snippet: The Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine, marketed as Comirnaty, received full FDA approval in August 2021 for individuals aged 16 and older. Prior to this, it was the first COVID-19 vaccine to receive FDA Emergency Use Authorization in December 2020, according to Yale Medicine. The FDA's approval was based on a thorough evaluation of the vaccine's safety and effectiveness data, including post-authorization surveillance data on myocarditis and pericarditis, according to the FDA.
